source: A 40-foot swimming speed and the ability to breathe underwater.
Oceanic Soul
You resist cold damage, and while you are fully submerged, any creature also fully submerged can understand your speech and you can understand its.
Guardian Coil
Your tentacle reduces damage to you or a creature near it by 1d8, rising to 2d8 at 10th level.
Grasping Tentacles

You learn Evard's black tentacles, a warlock spell for you that doesn't count against your spells known, and can cast it once per long rest without a spell slot. Casting it gives you temporary hit points equal to your warlock level, and damage can't break your concentration on it.
Fathomless Plunge
Teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures to a body of water within a mile; recharges on a short or long rest.
The Genie
A pact with a noble genie, carrying their element and a vessel you can climb inside.
Genie's Vessel

Your patron's kind (Dao, Djinni, Efreeti or Marid) sets your Genie's Wrath damage type and part of your expanded spells. Your vessel is a Tiny object (AC equal to your spell save DC, hit points equal to your warlock level + your proficiency bonus) and your spellcasting focus. Bottled Respite: as an action, vanish into it for up to twice your proficiency bonus in hours, leaving early as a bonus action; once per long rest. Genie's Wrath: once on each of your turns, a hit with an attack roll deals extra damage of your patron's type equal to your proficiency bonus (bludgeoning for a dao, thunder for a djinni, fire for an efreeti, cold for a marid).
Elemental Gift
You have resistance to your patron's damage type, and as a bonus action you gain a 30-foot flying speed (hovering) for 10 minutes, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Sanctuary Vessel

When you enter your vessel through Bottled Respite, up to five willing creatures within 30 feet can come in with you. Anyone who stays inside at least 10 minutes gains the benefit of a short rest, and anyone who spends Hit Dice in it adds your proficiency bonus to the hit points each die restores.
Limited Wish

As an action, you produce the effect of one spell of 6th level or lower, from any class's list, with a casting time of one action, ignoring its requirements and costly components. You can use it again only after 1d4 long rests.
Genie's Vessel
The Undead
A pact with a lich or worse: the warlock becomes a little more like their patron each level.
Form of Dread

As a bonus action, transform for a minute, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest: you gain 1d10 + your warlock level temporary hit points and immunity to being frightened, and once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can make it save on Wisdom against your spell save DC or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.
Grave Touched

You no longer need to eat, drink or breathe. Once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with an attack roll and roll damage, you can make that damage necrotic, and while in Form of Dread you roll one additional damage die.
Necrotic Husk

You have resistance to necrotic damage, and immunity to it while in Form of Dread. When you are reduced to 0 hit points, a reaction drops you to 1 hit point instead, and each creature of your choice within 30 feet takes 2d10 + your warlock level necrotic damage; you then gain a level of exhaustion. You can use the reaction again only after 1d4 long rests.
Spirit Projection

As an action, once per long rest, project your spirit from your body for up to an hour (concentration) while the body lies unconscious. Your spirit carries copies of your gear; you resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage; your conjuration and necromancy spells need no verbal or somatic components, nor material ones without a cost; you can fly at your walking speed and hover, passing through creatures and objects as difficult terrain (1d10 force damage if you end a turn inside one); and while in Form of Dread, once on each of your turns when you deal necrotic damage, you regain hit points equal to half of it.
The Undying
A pact with a deathless being that has cheated the grave and shares the trick.
Among the Dead

You learn spare the dying. An undead that targets you directly with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or choose another target or lose the attack or spell; this doesn't protect you from area effects, and an undead that succeeds, or that you target with an attack or harmful spell, is immune for 24 hours. You have advantage on saving throws against disease.
Defy Death
Regain 1d8 + your Constitution modifier hit points when you succeed on a death save or stabilize a creature; recharges on a long rest.
Undying Nature

You can hold your breath indefinitely and need no food, water or sleep (you still rest to recover from exhaustion and benefit from short and long rests), and you age at a tenth of the normal rate, immune to magical aging.
